Arcade adictivo que sirve de precuela de la saga UBERMOSH. Controlamos a un motorista que lleva a una artillera que debe destruir todo lo que se mueva para evitar sufrir daños y finalmente que llegue el temido Game Over.

- El concepto es simple, destruye todo en pantalla, y aguanta lo que puedas. No hay más.
- Los controles son simples también: WASD para mover al motorista, y el ratón para controlar dónde apunta la artillera.
- La música es algo repetitiva, pero sin llegar a molestar, acentuando el hecho de que es un arcade frenético.

Un buen juego para pasar el rato, y además es gratis.

Exactly like its sister series, Ubermosh, Swarm Riders is a volatile, frenetic, blast of a time.

Flee from a swarm of voracious insects, all while blasting away as many as you can. How long can you last? Not long. 

But don't worry: the game restarts at instant speed so you can try over and over and over again.

This is a fun, high paced game. Sort of similar to games like devil daggers. If you want to mow down crowds of enemies while listening to a rocking soundtrack, this is the game for you. Note though, that this game is not very large. Dont come in expecting hours upon hours of gameplay unless you are really into this style of game. Even then maybe not. This is probably a good game to do in small spurts. A single game is probably 3 minutes max (The maximum achievement is surviving 150 seconds and isn't super easy). 

PS: The soundtrack is awesome. 

tl;dr:
Game good. Game Small. Still Recommend.

SwarmRiders is a free 'n short bonus for fans of the UberMosh series in the form of a endless runner/endless mob mashup. 

No complaints, pretty fun. Can technically be 100%ed within 160 seconds, assuming perfection upon first try, but took me around 30 minutes.

Music is great and doesn't get too repetitive, which I was anticipating, but was glad it didn't. Walter Machado's games have some banger songs.

Anyone looking to try this out, I can recommend it, and it would be awesome inside an arcade machine.
